messages:
natalie: deploy-bot just opened a release bump from v1.14.3 -> v1.14.4 for PR #7122. PR title: "infra: add s3 lifecycle policy". This is config-only (infra/). Should we accept a patch bump for infra changes during the day window?

sam: personally I'd prefer skipping the patch bump for pure infra changes. We use buildmeta for non-functional changes.

ben: agreed in principle — earlier RFC said non-runtime changes shouldn't increment semver. The problem is deploy-bot auto-bumps on any merged PR.

maria: we need a consistent signal. either path-based filter (infra/, docs/, ci/) or a PR marker like [skip-patch]. both are fine to me. :+1:

natalie: quick diff pasted by the deploy-bot:
```
diff --git a/infra/s3/lifecycle.yml b/infra/s3/lifecycle.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..abcd123
+ lifecycle rule: enable expiration on logs/ for 90 days
```
no runtime code touched.

ben: can we do a short-term manual fix? retag the release to not bump and update deploy-bot rules in the next sprint. I don't want noise in release notes for infra churn.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: I detected changed files in paths matching: ["infra/", "deploy/"]. My config default is to bump patch on any merge to main unless PR title contains [skip-patch]. To avoid accidental skips, an explicit marker was chosen.

sam: ok, two questions: (1) do we retag now? (2) what's our rollback story if we later need to roll forward an infra-only change?

natalie: (1) I'm in favor of retagging to v1.14.3 and publishing a non-bump internal note. (2) rollback for infra should be identical to app rollback: we revert the infra PR and run the infra apply. We should document it.

ben: for retagging, command we'd run: `git tag -f v1.14.3 <commit>` and `git push -f origin v1.14.3` then update release notes to mark the infra change as non-release-impacting. keep a short changelog entry in 'infra changes' section.

maria: timeline: can we do that within the change window? ops window ends in 45m. If we wait, we risk a follow-up deploy bump landing and coupling.

natalie: i'll handle retag now. also proposing we add a small PR template checkbox: "Non-functional infra/config change — skip patch bump" so reviewers can tick it. That will be easier than asking for a title convention.

ben: +1 to checkbox. also add a rule to deploy-bot: if all changed files match `^(infra|deploy|ci|docs)/`, consider the PR non-functional and require explicit override to bump. safer default: skip patch unless a maintainer sets [force-patch].

deploy-bot: noted. I can implement a toggle. Current behavior: bump unless [skip-patch]. I will open a PR to add path-aware heuristics and support [force-patch] for overrides. ETA: next week.

sam: thanks. action items: natalie -- retag and add internal note; ben/maria -- propose checkbox + docs change; deploy-bot -- PR to change heuristics. If all good, we won't publish v1.14.4 as a semver bump.

natalie: retag done. `git tag -f v1.14.3 9f8d7c6` and pushed. internal note posted in release-tracker. Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
